Ava: Quick heads up — auditors asked to confirm keystore smoke windows next week. Can owners confirm availability for 3 slots? Proposed: Mon 9–10am, Wed 2–3pm, Fri 11–12pm. Need staging evidence path + who'll run smoke. @Jon @Priya @Marta
Jon: I can own Mon slot and run keystore smoke scripts. Will validate auditlog export and key thumbprint. ETA: create runbook by EOD today.
Priya: Wed works for infra team. Quick Q — do you want a live HSM attestation or recorded playback? Recorded is safer for staging.
Ava: Prefer recorded + live console walkthrough. Auditor requested HSM serial + RMS logs. Sam can you capture RMS logs?
Sam: Yep — will capture RMS logs and push to evidence-s3/staging/audit-1719876543. Will add hash and manifest. :white_check_mark:
Marta: I'll coordinate on Friday slot for revocation/rotation smoke. Also need to confirm KMS IAM entitlements for recording access. Who's the KMS owner?
Ben: That's me. I'll prebake a read-only role for auditors and add a short TTL key for the walkthrough. Will ping ops once role is created.
Ava: Awesome. Action items:
- Jon: runbook + smoke scripts (due today)
- Priya: staging orchestration + decide live vs recorded (confirm by EOD)
- Sam: log capture + evidence upload (Mon)
- Ben: create auditor role + TTL key (Mon)
- Marta: Friday rotation smoke owner (coordinate with Ben)

Please reply with thumbs when you can commit. If any blocker, flag here.
Jon: :thumbsup: 
Priya: :thumbsup: recorded ok
Sam: :thumbsup:
Ben: :thumbsup: will create role at 10am
Marta: :thumbsup: I'll run Friday
DeployBot: Reminder: staging env snapshot scheduled for 2024-10-22T08:00Z. If you need hold, comment with :no_entry_sign:
Ava: Noted, thanks all. I'll update the audit slot calendar invite once Jon's runbook link is in. Filing follow-ups in the evidence board.
Priya: runbook question — do we include the exact gcloud/az cli commands? prefer snippets. I'll add a short checklist.
Jon: Yep, will include snippets. Example:
```
# export auditlog
aws s3 cp /var/log/audit.log s3://evidence-staging/audit-1719876543/audit.log
# generate fingerprint
openssl x509 -noout -fingerprint -sha256 -in /path/to/cert.pem > cert.fp
```
Ava: Perfect. Last thing — can someone volunteer to be primary contact during the auditor session? Prefer someone on call Mon/Wed/Fri window.
Ben: I can be primary for Monday.
Marta: I'll be primary for Friday.
Priya: I'll be on standby Wed.
Ava: Thanks. Closing for now — will reopen if auditors ask for more. :pray:
